planCharacteristics.contractLegalName: BLUE CROSS OF IDAHO HEALTH SERVICE, INC.

BenefitUnlimitedComponent.bdBenefitUnlimitedDescription:
Two oral exams per calendar year.
One emergency oral exam per calendar year.
For x-rays, coverage is 1 bite wing every year: 1 full mouth x-ray every three years.
Same tooth surface restoration is covered once in a two year period.
Root canals not to exceed one per tooth per lifetime.
Root scaling and planing 1 procedure per quadrant every 2 years not to exceed 4 quadrants, full mouth debridement 1 procedure every 3 years, periodontal maintenance not to exceed 4 visits per year.
Bridge and bridge repair not to exceed one per tooth every seven years. One set of dentures is covered every seven years.
Implants not to exceed one per tooth every seven years.
Limited to one crown per year. Bridge, bridge repair, and crowns not to exceed one per tooth every seven years.
